visual_action: The video is a slideshow of still images and one short clip. It opens on a photo of Donald Trump smiling while seated at a table during an indoor event. This is followed by a still image from the movie "The Hunger Games" showing the character President Snow on a balcony. The video then shows a wider shot of Trump at the same event, then a still of characters from "The Hunger Games" in lavish outfits. A brief video clip then shows the party, featuring attendees in 1920s-style attire and a woman with a large feather fan, with Trump visible at a table. The video concludes with another still from "The Hunger Games" depicting a large, opulent party at a mansion.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: Donald Trump is shown in multiple photos at a party.

cast.name: Americans
cast.evidence: The on-screen text mentions that the party is happening "while americans lose SNAP and healthcare".

on_screen_text.text: great gatsby party at mar-a-lago while americans lose SNAP and healthcare btw

spoken_summary: There is no spoken dialogue in the video. The audio consists solely of a song.
audio_music: A somber, atmospheric song with a female vocalist plays throughout the video. The music creates a stark, critical contrast with the images of the lavish party.
editing_pacing: The video is a slow-paced slideshow of still images, intercut with one brief video clip.
central_claim: Donald Trump is hosting a decadent, out-of-touch party similar to those in "The Great Gatsby" and "The Hunger Games" while ordinary Americans are losing essential benefits like SNAP and healthcare.
intended_effect: To generate anger towards Donald Trump by portraying him as a cruel elite who is indifferent to the struggles of common people.
